thread:
eva: heads-up — noticed metric schema change in eval CI after quantized model bring-up on staging. 'accuracy' changed from simple scalar to nested object which breaks runner validation and dashboard ingestion.

ci-bot: [automated] eval-ci/staging #482 failed — metric schema mismatch (runner-validate). https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/482 :warning:

eva: example diff:
```
- metrics: { accuracy_at_1: 0.72 }
+ metrics: { accuracy: { top1: 0.72, top5: 0.95 } }
```

devin: :eyes: saw this with quantized v1.3. We changed postproc in model-adapter to emit new 'accuracy' object; older evals still expect accuracy_at_1. We should add a compatibility shim in eval-runner to flatten/extract top1.

mike: agree. quick fix: add normalization step in eval-runner pre-ingest. I'll sketch patch and add unit test.

sara: can we gate this in CI so new model PRs must declare metric-schema changes? Add a CI hook that validates metrics.json against the registry.

eva: yes — and we need a migration plan for historical rows in TSDB since dashboards expect accuracy_at_1.

devin: ingest alias is doable: if accuracy.top1 present, write accuracy_at_1 for downstreams. Need provenance field so we know it was derived.

mike: PR draft snippet (will expand):
```
# runner/metrics_normalizer.py
def normalize(metrics):
    if 'accuracy' in metrics and 'top1' in metrics['accuracy']:
        metrics['accuracy_at_1'] = metrics['accuracy']['top1']
    return metrics
```

mike: failing test: tests/test_metric_schema.py::test_backward_compat — I'll update it and add new schema test that allows both shapes.

sara: filing ticket and adding to onboarding checklist: 'declare metric contract + schema bump notice'. Ticket #4521 and added to eval-ops board.

eva: also emit a metric_schema_change event in tracing so we can correlate deployments and schema shifts. And alert on unknown top-level keys.

ci-bot: rerun triggered by @mike — eval-ci/staging #482 rerun queued.

mike: pushed shim to branch fix/metric-norm-201234 — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-runner/pull/978 :thumbsup:

devin: will coordinate with dashboards — @sara can you own migration plan for historical data? :pray:

sara: yep, drafting migration runbook today. will include backfill cost estimate and retention window impact.

eva: thanks all. after PR merges let's re-run full eval-suite across quantized and baseline models, then check regression dashboards and close ticket.

mike: noted, will add a quick smoke job to canary to catch future schema drift early. :white_check_mark:
